projects.name: SnapCast
description: SnapCast is a real-time screen and audio sharing app with a tiny footprint.
It pairs a WebRTC pipeline with a clean macOS-style interface, so sharing a window feels like using a native app.

projects.name: Converso
description: Converso is a language-practice chat app with an AI partner that adapts to your level.
It combines streaming responses with a lightweight design system built in Tailwind.

projects.name: PrepWise
description: PrepWise turns a job description into a focused interview prep plan.
It scores your résumé, highlights gaps, and generates practice questions tailored to the role.
